headline: CaramelClient BETA10 - banners, badges and a home screen that fits
summary: The home screen used to stack its buttons on top of the art and cut the news card in half. This beta is mostly about the parts you actually look at: real art on every news post, a badge that shows who else runs Caramel, and a layout that rearranges itself instead of squeezing. It also fixes the reason an update kept asking you to uninstall the old build first.

items.text: Emergency, urgent, Christmas and the Caramel+ announcement now have proper banner art instead of a gradient.
A post can name one of those banners, and a post that names none draws the art for its severity.
Announcements can be published without shipping a build, and they appear on the next launch.
Friends who run Caramel show the Caramel badge next to their name in the Xbox friends list.
The badge comes from the published list or from a reply the client has actually seen, not from a guess.
The Launch button and the three tab buttons no longer sit on top of the hero art, and Screenshots is no longer cut off.
The news column scrolls, so a card is not chopped at the bottom edge.
The friends card fills the side column instead of squashing the promo card into a sliver.
The hero drops its art and wraps its buttons when the window is short, instead of drawing them on top of each other.
The two-column home layout starts at 720dp, which is where it actually fits.
Every build is signed with the same key, so an update installs over the old version instead of asking you to delete it first.
This one may still ask once, because the beta you have now was signed with a different key. Every update after it installs straight over.
A session is recorded as live when it starts, as well as when it ends, so a crash no longer loses the time.
